jobs.title: Materials and Product Lifecycle Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**

Gimlet is building the first multi-silicon neocloud designed for fast, efficient AI inference.

We combine large-scale compute infrastructure with an execution platform that partitions AI workloads and maps each stage to the hardware best suited to run it.

We work with foundation labs, hyperscalers, and AI-native companies, giving our team access to technical problems spanning frontier models, production infrastructure, and emerging hardware.

**About the role**

As the Product Lifecycle & BOM Operations Program Manager at Gimlet, you will own the lifecycle of the hardware we procure and deploy across our data centers, from new part introduction to end of life. You will create and control internal part numbers, structure top-level assembly BOMs, keep part and BOM data accurate, and translate deployment plans into material requirements.

This role is the operational bridge between Engineering, Supply Chain, and infrastructure deployment. Your focus is making sure we have the right hardware, at the right revision, at the right time.

**What you'll do:**

**Product lifecycle management**

* Own the full part lifecycle: new part introduction, active production, end of life (EOL), and obsolescence.
* Monitor manufacturer EOL notices and product change notifications (PCNs), assess their impact on active and planned deployments, and drive last-time buys or qualified replacements with Engineering.
* Manage excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory, including disposition plans that minimize cost.

**Internal part numbering and part data**

* Create internal part numbers using a consistent numbering scheme, and map each one to its manufacturer part numbers (MPNs) and approved sources.
* Define and enforce part data standards: descriptions, units of measure, revision levels, lifecycle status, and approved manufacturer and vendor lists (AML/AVL).
* Read and interpret component datasheets and spec sheets to verify key attributes, such as form factor, electrical and thermal ratings, compatibility, and compliance, before a part is released.

**BOM structure and accuracy**

* Build and maintain multi-level BOMs, from top-level assemblies (racks, servers, networking) down to sub-assemblies and components.
* Own BOM accuracy: audit BOMs regularly, reconcile them against what is purchased, received, and deployed, and resolve discrepancies quickly.
* Control BOM releases and revisions through the engineering change process (ECR/ECO), and assess each change's impact on open orders, inventory, cost, and delivery.

**Material planning**

* Translate approved deployment plans into time-phased material requirements and purchasing priorities.
* Track long-lead components, shortages, and material readiness across suppliers and sites.
* Report material risks and recommended actions to Supply Chain and deployment leaders.

**What success looks like**

In your first 3 to 6 months, you will:

* Stand up a controlled internal part numbering scheme and part register covering all active deployments.
* Build released, revision-controlled top-level assembly BOMs for our core rack, server, and networking configurations.
* Set a BOM accuracy baseline and a regular audit process, with a clear target and a plan to close the gaps.
* Put an EOL and PCN monitoring process in place for critical components, with last-time-buy or replacement plans for at-risk parts.
* Define clear handoffs with Engineering for BOM releases and engineering changes.
* Build a material-readiness view tied to deployment milestones and purchasing priorities.
* Develop practical PLM and ERP workflows so Engineering, Supply Chain, and deployment teams work from one accurate, current source of part and BOM data.

**You may be a good fit if you have**

* 5+ years of experience in product lifecycle management, BOM management, materials planning, or hardware operations.
* Hands-on experience creating internal part numbers and structuring multi-level BOMs, from top-level assemblies down to components.
* A strong understanding of revision control, engineering change processes (ECR/ECO), and AML/AVL management.
* The ability to read and interpret datasheets and spec sheets for hardware such as servers, networking gear, power, cabling, and optics.
* Experience managing EOL notices, PCNs, last-time buys, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Experience translating changing deployment schedules into material plans, and managing long-lead components and shortages.
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced spreadsheet experience and hands-on use of PLM systems (such as Arena, Agile, or Windchill) and ERP systems (such as NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle).
* The ability to work closely with Engineering while respecting clear ownership: Engineering owns design, technical qualification, and substitutions; you own part data and BOM integrity.
* A track record of bringing structure and discipline to fast-moving hardware programs.

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience supporting data center, compute, networking, server, semiconductor, or other complex hardware deployments.
* Experience building a part numbering system, BOM standards, or PLM process from scratch in a fast-scaling company.
* Experience implementing, migrating, or improving PLM and ERP systems.
* Experience working across multiple suppliers, contract manufacturers or ODMs, deployment sites, and hardware configurations.
* An APICS/ASCM certification such as CPIM or CSCP.

**Why join now?**

Gimlet is expanding from its core technology into a production neocloud spanning new hardware, customers, and data centers.

* Solve hard problems.
* Own meaningful work.
* Build for production.
* Help define what’s next.

*Agency Policy:* *Gimlet Labs does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without a signed agreement will be considered the property of Gimlet Labs, and no fees will be paid.*

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Manager, Onboarding
jobs.description:
**About Factory**
-----------------

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.  
  
We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.  
  
In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

**About the Role**
------------------

Factory is pioneering autonomous software development. At the heart of this mission is our GTM organization, where we are rapidly scaling a world-class sales team to bring innovative developer tools to market.

We are seeking a visionary Sales Enablement Manager to architect, lead, and independently scale our end-to-end onboarding and certification strategy. In this foundational role, you will design the strategic playbook for selling Factory from the ground up, shaping how every new seller achieves consistent productivity.

Partnering closely with leaders and teams across Factory, you will define our sales methodology and build programs that turn technical innovations into enterprise adoption. If you thrive in an early-stage environment where you can autonomously own strategic initiatives and accelerate the future of software engineering, this is your opportunity to make a defining impact.

### **What you will do and achieve**

Program Strategy & Architecture

* Drive strategy and end-to-end execution for onboarding every new seller at Factory, from day one to their first closed deal.
* Independently build and scale the program by designing the strategic playbook for selling Factory where no prior template exists.
* Shape how new sellers sell at Factory, since every one of them starts in your program.

Bootcamp & Role-Based Certification

* Design and maintain comprehensive curriculum tracks for Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, and Sales Development Representatives, covering foundational company knowledge before diving into role-specific workflows.
* Lead interactive live training sessions for bootcamp cohorts, partnering closely with subject matter experts, moderators, and sales leaders to facilitate continuous learning.
* Establish clear evaluation criteria and certification standards for each role, holding new hires accountable and continuously refining content based on cohort performance and feedback.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management

* Partner with managers to establish and track 90-day onboarding plans, stepping in to support new hires who fall behind.
* Collaborate closely with senior sales leaders, founders, and cross-functional partners across Product, Solutions Engineering, and Revenue Operations to rapidly build out the enablement function.
* Regularly sync with sales managers, top reps, and subject matter experts to identify rep bottlenecks and deliver targeted training solutions.

Scalability, Delivery & AI Integration

* Package and scale training modules so sessions can be delivered seamlessly by managers and senior reps, supporting both local and remote sellers via live and self-paced learning.
* Maintain curriculum currency and relevance by continuously updating content as the product evolves and retiring obsolete materials.
* Leverage AI agents and automated workflows (such as Droids) to streamline program administration, update materials, and track seller readiness efficiently.

Continuous Learning & Performance Measurement

* Train experienced reps too, with launch updates, sales method refreshers at QBRs and Sales Kickoff, and focused help where we are losing deals.
* Track how long new hires take to close their first deal, how many reach quota, how they do on certification, and what changes in their calls.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Enablement Experience & Leadership: 5+ years in sales enablement focused on building, driving, and scaling end-to-end new-hire onboarding strategies from scratch.
* Instructional Design & Presentation: Deep expertise in instructional design principles, creating clear and attractive training collateral, and delivering engaging live presentations in person or virtually.
* Metrics & Execution: Highly organized and detail-oriented with a proven track record of tracking ramp metrics and optimizing enablement programs based on performance data.
* Technical Fluency & Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible training for non-technical sellers, fostering open two-way feedback.
* Startup & Preferred Background: Thrives in fast-paced early-stage environments. Experience as an AE/SE, background with dev tools, AI products, MEDDPICC/Command of the Message, or automating workflows with AI agents is strongly preferred.

**This is an in-office position (5 days/week) in San Francisco (walking distance to Caltrain)**

### **About Us**

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. As a member of Twitch's Revenue team, you'll use your industry and product acumen, and experience in digital advertising solutions to help grow Twitch Advertising revenue.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, client service focused Customer Success Manager with advertising experience that will work hand in hand with product and business development. The Customer Success Manager will be a crucial member of a growing team that will support Twitch in meeting its objectives and providing best in class client service to our clients that are specifically interested in our influencer marketing products. The ideal candidate will have experience with client management, media planning, and campaign operations.

* Experience helping clients execute media campaigns
* Excellent written, presentation and oral communication skills

* Able to proactively troubleshoot and problem solve quickly and though the proper escalation process

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Plaid’s Executive Assistant (EA) team sits within the People Team and partners closely with the company’s most senior leaders. Our EAs are trusted, strategic partners who help leaders stay focused on their highest-impact work—from managing complex calendars and preparing for critical meetings to coordinating Board logistics, leadership offsites, customer dinners, and company-wide events. We operate as one connected team, sharing best practices, supporting one another, and exploring new technology and AI-enabled approaches to make the way we work faster, smarter, and more effective.

As the EA Team Lead, you’ll lead and develop a team of EAs who support senior leaders across Plaid, while also directly supporting one of our C-Suite executives. You’ll set clear standards, bring consistency and best practices to high-impact areas such as leadership rhythms, onsite planning, and company events, and serve as a trusted partner to executives and People Team leaders. You’ll also help evolve and scale the function through new approaches to technology, AI, and automation.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of EAs through regular 1:1s, candid feedback, goal setting, and career development.
* Provide direct support for one C-Suite Executive and back up coverage as needed.
* Set the vision and operating standards for the EA program, including onboarding, role expectations, coverage, and ways of working.
* Build scalable playbooks, templates, and repeatable approaches for leadership meetings, onsite planning, All Hands, company events, and other high-impact programs.
* Foster a connected EA community through shared practices, knowledge sharing, and thoughtful coverage across the team.
* Partner with executives and their EAs to understand priorities, calibrate support, and ensure the right level of coverage.
* Own hiring for the EA team, including defining the bar, partnering with Recruiting, and onboarding new hires.
* Identify and implement efficiencies through technology, AI, and automation to improve how the team works.
* Serve as an escalation point and thought partner for complex, sensitive, or cross-functional situations.
* Partner with the People Team on programs and initiatives involving executive and leadership support.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience as an EA supporting C-suite executives in complex, fast-paced environments.
* 3-5 years of experience leading, coaching, or managing EAs or administrative teams.
* A track record of developing people, with the ability to give clear, direct feedback and help others grow.
* Experience planning and running complex programs and events, such as leadership onsites, Board meetings, All Hands, and company events.
* A strategic and operational mindset, with the ability to turn recurring work into scalable, repeatable systems.
* Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information.
* Ability to build trust and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners without relying on authority.
* Builder mindset, with comfort using technology, AI, and automation to improve how work gets done.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort operating at a fast pace, navigating shifting priorities, and working flexibly when the needs of the business require it.

jobs.description:
**Location: Palo Alto, CA (onsite)**

NEXT's mission is to help entrepreneurs thrive. We're doing that by building the only technology-led, full-stack provider of small business insurance in the industry, taking on the entire value chain and transforming the customer experience.

Simply put, wherever you find small businesses, you'll find NEXT.

Since 2016, we've helped hundreds of thousands of small business customers across the United States get fast, customized and affordable coverage. We're backed by industry leaders in insurance and tech, and we still have room to grow—that's where you come in.

Our People & Facilities Team makes sure Next Insurance is a phenomenal place to work every day. We're responsible for building, growing and developing the careers of the extraordinary people who work here. This will be a unique role supporting a hybrid workplace and overseeing day to day office operations in our Palo Alto, CA office. You will report to the Head of Workplace/Facilities and be a close partner to site leaders in Palo Alto. Our ideal candidate will have the desire to constantly learn new things, always be willing to help, possess a positive & collaborative spirit, and can thrive with little supervision.

**What You'll Do:**

* Oversee and manage daily office operations to ensure efficiency, happiness, and productivity.
* Acting as the face of the office and the point of contact with building management, internal employees & cross-functional partners
* Coordinate administrative activities, including managing vendor schedules, company meetings, onsite offsites, greeting and touring visitors/candidates, etc.
* Exhibit supreme attention to detail to provide a sparkling workspace that's inviting and clean.
* Ensuring the office environment is on-brand and reflects the values of NEXT.
* Coordinate and execute engaging events like company milestones, weekly brunches, holiday parties, and surprise & delight moments.
* Maintain office supplies inventory and ensure proper stocking levels.
* Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence, including emails, Slacks, tickets, and occasional phone calls.
* Sorting, routing mail to the proper department; sometimes scanning important claims or financial related materials.
* Manage office budgets and expenses.
* Assist in People-related tasks such as tours, hosting visitors/candidates, and setting the tone to provide an uplifting office experience.
* Implement and maintain office policies and procedures to uphold organizational standards.
* Coordinate office maintenance and repairs, liaising with vendors and service providers.
* Assist in special projects as needed.
* Overseeing office moves, reshuffles, furniture placement, and upgrades to the built environment.
* Prep space as needed for specific meeting types (e.g. onsites, trainings, all-hands, partner meetings, events, etc.).

**What We Need:**

* Associates or Bachelor's degree in hospitality, human resources, facilities, or related fields preferred.

jobs.title: Annotation Operations Lead, Autonomy
jobs.description:
Rivian Autonomy is seeking an AI Data Operation Lead to lead the people and processes that turn vehicle data into reliable training and evaluation datasets. Within the AI Platform organization, you will bring together labeling delivery, data quality, curation, and human review to support the development of our autonomous driving models.

You will lead internal teams and external partners, with accountability for delivery, quality, and cost. This includes making sure the data we send for annotation is usable, that accepted labels meet the model teams' requirements, and that reviewers can turn difficult driving events into actionable feedback for engineering.

You will work closely with Perception, Planning, Data Infrastructure, Eval Infrastructure, and Product to translate model-development priorities into operational plans and provide evidence for release decisions. We are looking for a leader who can develop managers and specialists, make clear tradeoffs when demand exceeds capacity, and build an operation that improves as our models, tools, and vehicle fleet evolve.

* **Lead the organization.** Set the operating plan for AI data operations, develop team leaders, and define responsibilities across employees, contractors, and vendors. Build capacity plans that account for annotation, quality review, and rework across concurrent programs.
* **Deliver data that model teams can use.** Translate training and evaluation needs into labeling specifications, reviewer guidance, delivery milestones, and acceptance criteria. Work with model teams on taxonomy changes and keep delivery aligned with their development cycles.
* **Improve data quality and yield.** Own the operational checks that determine whether collected vehicle data is ready for curation and labeling. Partner with collection and engineering teams to resolve sensor, calibration, and data-quality issues before they consume downstream annotation capacity.
* **Own vendor performance and spend.** Set service levels and quality expectations, evaluate suppliers, and manage capacity, pricing, and budgets with Finance and Procurement. Reconcile accepted work with invoices and address delivery or quality shortfalls through clear corrective actions.
* **Develop human evaluation and triage operations.** Build review workflows with autonomy and systems engineers to investigate driving events, classify recurring failures, and assemble the evidence needed for root-cause analysis. Feed those findings into scenario selection, evaluation datasets, and targeted data requests.
* **Run the operation with consistent metrics.** Establish a shared view of accepted-data volume, quality, turnaround time, backlog, rework, collection yield, and cost. Use these measures to identify constraints, allocate review capacity, and make delivery commitments teams can plan around.
* **Improve tools and automation.** Partner with Data Infrastructure, Eval Infrastructure, and Applied General AI on labeling tools, prelabels, automated quality checks, and assisted triage. Define operational requirements and validate improvements against measured quality and reviewer effort before scaling them.

  

* 10+ years leading operations, including at least 5 years supporting autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex machine-learning programs, with responsibility for budgets or a P&L.
* Experience managing annotation partners across domestic and international locations, including commercial negotiations, staffing plans, and service delivery.
* Enough technical depth in AI development to discuss data requirements and failure analysis with engineers and turn those discussions into clear work for operations teams.
* A record of developing managers and specialists, establishing ownership, and adapting team structures as priorities change.
* Strong analytical judgment: you can separate a quality problem from a capacity or tooling problem, test the cause, and follow through on the fix.
* Clear communication across engineering, product, finance, and operations, with the ability to make prioritization decisions and explain their impact on delivery.

**Bonus Points**

* Direct experience supporting autonomous driving or other physical AI systems through data production and evaluation.
* Experience applying large language models, multimodal models, or generative AI to annotation and human-review workflows.

##### **Why This Role Matters**

Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character and community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a School-Based Club team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

##### **What You’ll Do**

Program Leaders are assigned to a Clubhouse department based on their knowledge and expertise, where they design and lead tailored programs, coordinate and supervise field trips, and independently oversee day-to-day department operations. You’ll play a direct role in shaping the lives of youth in our community, and the position is a stepping stone into Clubhouse leadership.

##### **What You Bring**

This role will own product and process gap analysis — identifying where our TPO platform falls short against enterprise partner needs, investor requirements, and operational best practices — and translate those findings into actionable requirements for engineering and process improvements for operations. The ideal candidate will have experience in solar finance, business analysis, or operations and will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets, and Risk teams.

* Analyze PI (Partner Installer) behavior patterns using Salesforce data to identify systemic risks such as production overstatement, CO circumvention, and documentation non-compliance, and recommend systemic controls.

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, data analytics, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of professional work experience in business analysis, operations analysis, management consulting, or strategy/operations role in solar finance, fintech, or financial services.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to map complex multi-step processes, identify failure points, and propose structured solutions — comfort with process flow mapping and root cause analysis.

* Proficiency in Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (structured presentations for leadership audiences).

* Excellent written communication — ability to produce clear, structured gap analysis documents, SOPs, and requirements specifications.

* Comfort working across multiple teams simultaneously (Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets) in a fast-paced environment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in residential solar TPO operations, loan servicing, or asset management — familiarity with milestone-based workflows (NTP, M1, M2, M3).

* Familiarity with Salesforce as a system of record and experience pulling operational data for analysis.

* Exposure to investor reporting, capital markets due diligence, or portfolio quality analysis in a renewable energy or structured finance context.

* Experience with process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma) or project management tools (Jira, Asana, Miro).

* SQL or BI tool experience (Tableau, Looker) for operational data analysis is a plus.

**WHY QCELLS?:**

This is an opportunity to lead an end-to-end North American BESS business and shape its strategy, growth, product portfolio, commercial model, supply chain, and execution platform.

The role offers direct executive visibility with Qcells and Hanwha leadership and the opportunity to build a scalable BESS organization across the North American market.

Qcells is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

* Zone 2 (CA, NJ, NY): $110,300 – $132,300

* Zone 3 (All others): $100,300 – $120,300

The applicable salary range is based on the employee’s primary work location. Individual compensation will be determined based on qualifications, relevant experience, education, skills, internal equity, and other business-related factors.

jobs.description:
Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to.

**Position Overview:**

The Healthcare Practice Program Manager owns end-to-end operational performance of Harbor IT's Healthcare POD: the clients, the 9-person delivery team, the projects, and the service delivery workflows that hold it together. This role directly manages a Solution Architect, 3 Sr. Systems Engineers, 3 Technical Support Specialist IIs, 1 Technical Support Specialist, and 1 Project Manager. The POD-CIO and CSM sit inside the POD but report outside it into CX Leadership — the Program Manager is expected to operate in lockstep with both, especially on clinical escalations and EMR-related incidents, but does not manage them.

**Organizational Structure:**

Reports to the Healthcare Practice Director. The POD-CIO owns executive relationships, strategic IT roadmap, and expansion positioning. The CSM owns day-to-day client ops and satisfaction. This role owns POD delivery performance, SLA/KPI attainment, the delivery team, PMO and project outcomes, PSA data integrity, delivery margin inputs, and renewal execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Communicate directly and credibly with physicians, practice administrators, office managers, and clinical staff — translating technical issues into language a non-technical clinical audience can act on, and managing expectations during outages or go-lives.

* Lead the POD's PMO function: EMR migrations, system upgrades, new clinic onboarding, and infrastructure projects, from scoping through closeout.

obligations relevant to healthcare clients; partner with security/compliance functions on audits and risk findings.

* Join client SBRs and project reviews, packaging performance and clinical-impact narratives for practice leadership and executive sponsors.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

performance accountability.

* Working knowledge of HIPAA, HITECH, and healthcare compliance requirements as they

intersect with IT service delivery.

number.

jobs.title: Federal Acquisition Support Manager

Overview:

Planned Systems International (PSI) is an Enterprise IT services company who focuses on designing, building, securing, and operating cutting-edge software solutions that drive mission success and operational excellence for Federal Government organizations. PSI is currently seeking a Federal Acquisition Support Manager to join a Program Management Office (PMO) Support team supporting the VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) Product Line.

This critical role primarily focuses on supporting the LGY Government Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) team with contract administration activities, monitoring contract deliverables and invoice approvals, coordinating acquisition documentation, and serving as the primary contract-management resource for software development and operations efforts.

The position is a contractor support role within a PMO Support Team and serves as a vital bridge among Government program personnel, procurement organizations, budget/finance personnel, and the IT contractor. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in federal contracting, experience supporting federal programs or COR functions, and the independent judgment to translate evolving requirements into clear contract-management actions in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities:

* Support a Government program team in contract administration activities for federal contracts and task orders supporting VA LGY Product Line initiatives.
* Lead the development of contract documentation through the entire acquisition lifecycle, from initial requirements development to submission of compliant procurement packages.
* Monitor monthly contract deliverables; coordinate review, disposition, and approval by the appropriate Government authorities; and verify alignment with contractual requirements, schedules, quality standards, and program objectives.
* Serve as a primary contract-management resource for the COR team, providing contract guidance and interpretation to internal teams, contractors, and Government stakeholders.
* Facilitate and lead recurring contract status meetings with VA leadership, program managers, CORs, Contracting Officers (COs), budget personnel, and contractor personnel, serving as an interface between the IT contractor and Government stakeholders.
* Coordinate closely with budget and finance personnel to track contract funding across Contract Line Item Numbers (CLINs) and support budget planning, execution, and funding-related contract actions.
* Maintain accurate contract documentation, acquisition records, action items, status reports, meeting minutes, and milestone tracking.
* Help manage and track contract-specific processes for initiating, planning, and executing mission-specific work, including optional-task activities and associated documentation.
* Utilize Jira, Microsoft SharePoint, and other project management tools to manage project activities, monitor workflows, track deliverables, maintain documentation, and facilitate issue resolution across teams and stakeholders.
* Coordinate across program management, budget/finance, procurement and procurement-support organizations, technical teams, and contractor personnel to advance contract actions and meet program and procurement timelines.
* Identify contract risks, performance concerns, funding issues, and process gaps, and use independent judgment to recommend practical mitigation and resolution approaches.
* Support contract modifications, invoice review and approval tracking, vendor coordination, performance evaluations, and compliance reporting.
* Draft, edit, review, and coordinate contract and acquisition documentation, including Performance Work Statements (PWSs) sections, in-scope determinations/memoranda, Justifications and Approvals (J&As), and related acquisition artifacts; support budget personnel in the development and review of Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs).
* Apply federal acquisition knowledge and independent judgment to evolving program needs, identify required contract-management actions, and recommend practical paths forward in a fast-paced environment.
* Translate program and technical requirements into clear contract-related documentation and procurement-ready acquisition artifacts for Government review.
* Provide advisory and technical support to CORs and PMO leadership on acquisition, contract-management, and program-support matters.
* Facilitate stakeholder communication and build working consensus among program, acquisition, budget, technical, and contractor teams when requirements, interpretations, priorities, or trade-offs differ.
* Support Government stakeholders in applying the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR), agency policies, and contractual requirements.
* Conduct research on special topics and recommend solutions to government clients.
* Facilitate executive-level virtual meetings, including preparing meeting agendas, capturing minutes, and tracking outcomes and action items.
* Work proactively and independently to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices.
* Function as part of an integrated team sharing products, best practices, and information across the PMO Support Team.
* Perform related duties as assigned by supervisor.

Minimum Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree.
* At least 8 years of total professional experience with 5+ years in federal acquisition, contract management, COR support, and/or federal program/PMO support, preferably supporting IT modernization projects.
* Federal acquisition certifications (FAC-C, FAC-C Professional, FAC-COR).
* Strong knowledge of Federal acquisition and contract-support documentation for IT or professional services contracts, the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Government budgeting and procurement lifecycles
* Experience supporting Independent Government Cost Estimates

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Lead & Program Manager - Content Experience Innovation
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

  
  

**Our Team**

  

The Content Experience Innovation (CEI) product team is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with new content types. This includes 0 to 1 areas such as Live events, Podcasts, Creator content, Games discovery and more. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces. We sit at the intersection of Product, Tech, Content, and Production, and act as the connective tissue that keeps our product surface in step with our content strategy.

  
  

This role sits on the Configurations team within Content Experience Innovation (CEI), connecting CEI with the broader business through configurable, high-velocity capabilities that scale globally and for every content type. We are looking for a Senior Product Operations Lead/Program Manager to join our team.

You’ll also be responsible for aligning those operating rhythms to those of our partner teams across Product + Tech, working in lock step with the Prod Ops partners Member Experience and Commerce product orgs to ensure we all work together toward a cohesive end member experience. You’ll also flex into Program Management to drive critical innovation programs across the team to bring our product vision to life.

**What You’ll Bring**

  

* 10+ years of Product Operations, Product or Program Management, Business Operations, or related experience in a product-driven organization.

**IT Operations Manager**

The IT Operations Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for enterprise technology services supporting mission-critical programs, grants management, volunteer service initiatives, disaster response activities, and agency business operations. This role oversees day-to-day IT operations while serving as a senior technical advisor responsible for cloud infrastructure, enterprise applications, cybersecurity coordination, change management, operational governance, and modernization initiatives.

The position requires a blend of leadership, technical expertise, project management, and stakeholder engagement to ensure secure, reliable, and compliant technology services.

**Program Support and Disaster Response Technology**

* Support technology platforms that enable client’s programs and mission operations.
* Coordinate IT services supporting disaster services initiatives and emergency response capabilities.
* Ensure operational readiness of systems that support program delivery and field activities.

**Vendor, Contractor, and Team Leadership**

* Coordinate work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity, networking, and application support teams.
* Support workforce planning, onboarding, performance management, and training initiatives.

**Strategic Planning and Modernization**

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation and process improvement.
* Lead modernization initiatives involving cloud adoption, security enhancement, and service transformation.

The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Navigate competing priorities across internal teams and practice stakeholders while keeping launch objectives in focus. Articulate the business case and rationale ("why") behind launch initiatives to leadership, internal teams, and practice-facing audiences. Define operational guidelines and quality gates for AI-assisted workflows to ensure data accuracy, prevent tracking errors, and uphold long-term maintainability. Develop reusable prompt templates and workflow accelerators to empower the team and unlock capacity for high-impact program management. jobs.description:
20 Oct 2026

3 Nov 2026 - 02:52 UTC

Worldwide

Programme Operations

  

Subject to donor approval
  
**Location:** Sidoarjo or Malang District, East Java, Indonesia, with regular support to program operations with our implementing partners in Bogor and Depok (West Java)
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
  
The TUNTAS Program Manager is the senior operational lead for the TUNTAS program. The role sets strategic direction, ensures technical quality, and makes sure program investments draw on Indonesia’s wider education system and donor landscape.
  
The role leads the design and delivery of an integrated package of technical assistance to district and provincial governments. The program aims to reduce school dropout and improve educational outcomes for vulnerable children and young people. It does this by strengthening access to inclusive, quality, and relevant learning through youth empowerment, school and community engagement, and sustainable education systems. It covers four districts in the two provinces with the highest concentration of dropout risk: Bogor and Depok (West Java), and Sidoarjo and Malang (East Java).
  
The role keeps the TUNTAS program design consistent and connected with other Save the Children initiatives in Indonesia, and aligned with the DBS Foundation, to maximize impact and support lasting system change. The position requires deep expertise in the Indonesian education system, both formal and non-formal. It also requires proven experience delivering large-scale capacity building at the local level and a strong grounding in adult learning and systems-strengthening approaches.
  
**KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY**
  
**Technical Leadership and Program Quality**

* Lead the overall implementation of the TUNTAS program across target locations, in line with the approved program design, donor commitments, national education priorities, and Save the Children’s policies and quality standards.
* Under the direction of the Head of Children Development, provide operational leadership, strategic implementation planning, and coordination across program components and locations.
* Work closely with the Education Technical Advisor and relevant technical specialists so that education interventions are technically sound, contextually appropriate, inclusive, and consistently implemented.
* Integrate life skills, dropout prevention, education continuity, and re-engagement pathways into one coherent program approach.
* Systematically integrate Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), climate change, child protection, and child participation into program design and implementation.
* Adjust work plans based on field data and monitoring results, resolve implementation issues quickly, and follow up on stakeholder feedback.

**Oversight and Management of Project Implementation**

* Coordinate the overall project, working closely with direct reports, local implementing partners, and stakeholders to deliver a high-quality program.
* Develop a Detailed Implementation Plan for all program areas. Ensure on-time delivery that meets the quality framework and standards, including monitoring and evaluation, and that program approaches work together.
* Ensure adherence to good programming guidelines, including international good practice.
* Raise any implementation issues with the line manager, with recommendations for resolution.
* Work with the Program Impact & Policy Department to maintain program quality framework standards and identify opportunities for scaling up work in project areas.
* Coordinate external technical assistance visits from Jakarta-based and international staff, as well as the donor.
* Ensure timely and accurate narrative and financial reporting to the National Office and Save the Children Members.
* Maintain a green rating on program KPIs, as reviewed monthly by Save the Children.

**Financial Management**

* Develop program budgets and projections with the program and Finance teams.
* Ensure effective and efficient use of project resources.
* Regularly monitor budget vs. actual expenditure and proactively propose changes to expenditure plans and projections.
* Apply appropriate controls to project resources, including accurate tracking of all expenditure and financial management and tracking for implementing partners.
* Coordinate with the Finance unit to produce accurate and timely financial reports.
* Review financial reports to confirm they match project activities.

**Partnership Management, Eco-Convener and Localization**

* Manage program implementation through local partners, applying the localization roadmap across its seven dimensions.
* Secure the resources needed for program success, in line with Save the Children and donor standards.
* Support the growth of SC Indonesia’s portfolio through staff capacity building, partnership and network development, and new funding opportunities. Provide evidence-based, strategic input to proposal development, drawing on learning and evaluation from ongoing projects and regular assessment and research with relevant departments.

jobs.title: Hardware Deployment Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Gather AI**  
Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery.  
If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.  
**About the Team**  
Gather AI's Hardware team designs, builds and supports the hardware behind our platform: autonomous inventory drones and camera systems that mount on customers' material handling equipment (MHE). The team includes hardware engineers and technicians who work out of the Pittsburgh HQ. Hardware designs and builds new product implementations, reviews and repairs RMAs, and performs detailed analysis of field failures while Field Ops runs day-to-day customer site support.  
**About the role**  
Our robots are already working in customer warehouses, and every new deployment depends on the right hardware arriving built, configured and ready. In this role, you'll own the hardware side of that: deployment readiness, field hardware escalations and returns, and accurate documentation of deployment configurations and bill of materials (BOMs) across Hardware programs. This is an ownership role and much of the processes behind it are yours to build collaboratively with Hardware leadership. As our Hardware Deployment & Development Coordinator, you'll be the hardware team's hub between development and field operations: making sure each deployment's hardware is ready on time, owning how we handle field hardware issues and returns, and keeping our bills of materials and fleet configurations accurate across all our hardware programs. You'll report to our Director of Hardware and work closely with engineers, technicians, Field Ops, Purchasing and customer implementation teams.  
**What you'll do**

* Own hardware readiness for each customer deployment: build schedules, kit lists, parts status, shipping and site prerequisites.
* Be on site for installs and go-lives as the hardware liaison lead, then hand off cleanly to Field Ops.
* Own tier-2 hardware escalations: triage, route to the right technician or engineer, and close the loop.
* Own our RMA process: intake, disposition, failure analysis coordination and trend reporting back to engineering and suppliers.
* Own BOM accuracy and configuration management across programs, including revision control and serial/config traceability.
* Build and document the processes behind the work, including the readiness checklist, RMA workflow and configuration control.
* Plan development builds and test assets with engineering and the technicians, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Coordinate development builds, test assets and technician schedules, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Give Purchasing a clear demand plan and flag long-lead and single-source risks early.

**What you bring**

* You've owned hardware readiness for deployments, production launches or NPI builds end to end —, covering schedules, kits, parts and handoffs — and kept other teams moving toward the date without direct authority.
* You've owned the record of what hardware is built and implemented: BOMs and revisions, configurations and change control, or RMA processes. Ideally you've build one of these, not just owned it.a BOM or configuration record, an inventory system or an RMA process.
* You can read assembly and part drawings, electrical schematics, and understand critical to quality callouts. drawings and harness pinouts, and you're comfortable getting hands-on to troubleshoot hardware.
* You can take a field escalation from first report to resolution and keep everyone informed along the way.
* You're detail-oriented, agile and adaptable and adapt quickly when plans change.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in warehouse, material handling or forklift environments.
* Robotics or autonomous-vehicle deployment experience.
* Experience working with suppliers or contract manufacturers on ECOs or recurring defects.Experience coordinating with suppliers or contract manufacturers.
* Experience with Document Control, Good Documentation Practices, and Good Manufacturing Practices.

**Location** Pittsburgh, PA (on site) or remote in the US. About one week a month on site in Pittsburgh; when a customer deployment is active, travel to that site takes priority. Eastern time zone is a plus.  
**How we hire** A recruiter conversation, a conversation with the hiring manager, a practical deployment-planning exercise, and a final round with the team. We'll tell you before each step whether AI tools are welcome.

**Project Coordinator I: Project Management & Client Support – (CA, AZ, & MA)**

**About iQ Biosciences**

iQ Biosciences (iQ) is a specialized preclinical research partner dedicated to helping drug developers ask the right questions early to generate meaningful data and make confident decisions throughout development. Since 2014, our immunology expertise, coupled with our agility, drive, and collaborative approach, has made us the partner of choice for research organizations of all sizes and across a range of therapeutic areas. iQ offers an integrated, scientist-led model that combines three core capabilities – high-quality cellular products, in vitro bioservices, and custom bioconjugation – and a commitment to being as passionate about its clients' research as they are.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Senior Project Manager, the Project Coordinator I supports the successful delivery of scientific projects and contributes to inside-sales activities. This entry-level role will work closely with the Senior Project Manager and cross-functional scientific and operational teams to keep projects organized, communications timely, and client records current.

The position is designed for someone who is organized, client-focused, and wants to build a career in biotechnology project management, client services, or inside sales. Responsibilities may shift based on business needs and the employee’s strengths, interests, and demonstrated capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing role. Relevant experience may come from biotechnology, a contract research organization, hospitality, restaurants, or another service-oriented environment.

* **Proactive:** You anticipate next steps, identify potential risks or gaps, and take action before they become larger issues.
* **Organized:** You can manage multiple projects, priorities, timelines, and follow-up items while maintaining attention to detail.
* **Detail-oriented:** You consistently produce accurate, thorough work and carefully review project details, pricing, documentation, and communications before they are finalized.
* **Collaborative:** You work effectively with scientific, operational, business development, and finance teams to keep projects moving.
* **Clear communicator:** You communicate thoughtfully and professionally, adapting the level of detail for clients and internal teams.
* **Adaptable:** You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where project needs, timelines, and priorities may change.

**General Information**

* Full-time, exempt position.
* Candidates **may be based in California, Arizona, or Massachusetts only.** On-site/hybrid in Alameda, CA preferred. Remote work from California, Arizona, or Massachusetts will be considered.
* Relocation assistance: No
* Occasional travel of 10%-15% may be required for conferences, client meetings, or company activities.
* Schedule: Based on location. Must be able to overlap hours to PST operating hours. Occasional night or weekend work may be required.
* Compensation: Range $60,000 to $83,000 annually, based on location/experience.
* Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with employer match after the introductory period, paid holidays, PTO, EAP, life and long-term disability insurance, FSA with employer contribution, and company-provided lunch/snacks.

This job description outlines the position's primary duties and requirements. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to support the goals and objectives of the organization.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager - Healthcare
jobs.description:
###### **About Vasion**

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

###### **About the role**

Vasion is looking for a Technical Account Manager who becomes the technical point of contact for our healthcare customers after the sale, working with hospital and health-system IT teams, from day-to-day administrators to IT directors, to keep the platform healthy, adopted, and growing long after go-live. We modernize how organizations handle documents, print, and content workflows, replacing fragmented legacy tools with a single, secure platform. In healthcare, that means print and document workflows that clinicians never have to think about, and IT teams that are never surprised.

###### **At a Glance**

* **Segment:** Healthcare accounts: hospitals, health systems, and multi-site provider networks
* **Vertical focus:** Healthcare
* **Engagement model:** Post-sales technical ownership across adoption, retention, and expansion
* **Work model:** Remote; ability to travel up to 20% [confirm]
* **Success metrics:** Gross retention on assigned accounts, risk identified before the customer raises it, adoption milestones met, expansion ARR influenced

###### **What Success Looks Like**

You find problems before our customers do. Every account in your book has a current technical plan that the customer's own technical owner has agreed to, and that plan already accounts for the EHR upgrade, the new clinic opening, and the audit that are coming. Escalations end with a root cause and a fix that holds. Renewals are a confirmation, not a negotiation, because the technical trust was built a year earlier.

###### **What you'll do**

**Ownership of the technical relationship across healthcare accounts: preventing risk, driving adoption, and growing customers over time.**

* **Proactive technical advisory:** Anticipate deployment, adoption, and stability risk across your accounts before the customer raises it. Turn release changes, configuration drift, and usage patterns into recommendations that name the risk, the likely impact, and the choice available to the customer, and be clear about which conclusions are firm and which need more evidence.
* **Technical account planning:** Own a twelve-month technical plan for each account, grounded in the health system's real growth, projects, and constraints, and agreed with the customer's technical owner. Keep a forward calendar of EHR upgrades and cutovers, new site openings, acquisitions, audits, and clinical change freezes, so Vasion hears about them before they arrive as escalations.
* **Clinical workflow adoption:** Help customers get the full value of what they already own, including secure pull and badge-based printing, serverless print management, and EHR-connected print and document workflows across shared clinical workstations and virtual desktops. Convert unused capability into adoption commitments.
* **Escalation leadership:** Lead the technical response when one of your accounts escalates, especially when printing or document delivery touches patient-facing operations. Coordinate Support and Engineering, give the customer one voice, and confirm the fix has held before closing it out.
* **Service delivery and renewal support:** Manage entitlement consumption across your book, coordinate Professional Services, Support, and partners, and give Customer Success the technical input needed to protect renewals, quarters ahead.
* **Expansion:** Identify new use cases inside the account, such as document workflow and capture needs, and build the technical case with Customer Success and Sales.
* **Field feedback and enablement:** Share healthcare field insight with Product and Engineering, and contribute runbooks, health-check templates, and reference architectures to the shared library.

###### **What You Bring**

**Strong technical grounding, healthcare IT fluency, and a structured approach to keeping accounts healthy and growing:**

* **Post-sales technical advisory:** Health reviews, adoption planning, review delivery, escalation coordination, and clear communication from IT administrator to Director level.
* **Architecture and systems thinking:** Ability to read and critique a customer's deployment architecture, including multi-site and virtualized environments.
* **Networking and identity:** Troubleshooting DNS, proxies, and firewalls; strong grasp of LDAP and SSO (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping), plus badge and tap-to-authenticate workflows such as Imprivata.
* **Security and compliance:** Working knowledge of HIPAA and HITECH requirements as they apply to print and output management; awareness of SOC 2 and ISO.
* **Domain expertise:** Print, Workflow, and Output Automation in cloud and hybrid environments; familiarity with EHR platforms (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner) and the print and document patterns around them.
* **Technical toolbox:** Diagramming; bash and/or PowerShell; SQL basics; RESTful APIs; Jira; AI-assisted workflows.

###### **Qualifications**

**Hands-on post-sales experience and the technical depth to earn trust with customer administrators:**

* 3-5+ years in technical account management, post-sales engineering, or senior technical support for SaaS or enterprise software
* Track record owning enterprise accounts through renewal cycles and escalations
* Comfortable engaging technical owners and decision makers, with strong writing and presentation skills

Volunteer Program Lead

### **About International Foundation for Autoimmune & Autoinflammatory Arthritis**

We are leaders in advancing education, advocacy, and research for those impacted by autoimmune and autoinflammatory arthritis (AiArthritis) diseases through peer-led guidance, collaboration, and resources that are driven by patient-identified issues and patient-infused solutions.

### **Description**

The International Foundation for Autoimmune & Autoinflammatory Arthritis (AiArthritis) is an international nonprofit organization dedicated to improving the lives of people living with autoimmune and autoinflammatory arthritis diseases through education and awareness, advocacy, research, and extensive community engagement.

As we continue to build our community presence, we are looking for an experienced volunteer program leader to help expand our efforts to build a robust USA presence and improved international presence, including both in person and online opportunities.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Volunteer Program Lead is responsible for growing, maintaining, and leading AiArthritis’ volunteer program. They will initially conduct an audit of the existing program, including all processes, and make recommendations for improvement based on organization goals to expand volunteer opportunities. This role includes recruitment, onboarding, placement, training, engagement, supervision, evaluation, and recognition.

The Volunteer Program Lead will collaborate closely with leadership and program teams to identify volunteer needs, match volunteers to appropriate roles, and support the organization in scaling its initiatives through a robust, well-supported volunteer workforce.

The Volunteer Program Lead will coordinate volunteers for all managers and directors (4-6 individuals).

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Program Development & Strategy**
----------------------------------

* Use professional experience to audit existing volunteer program, identifying areas for improvement, then recommending and implementing new processes.
* Update and implement volunteer role descriptions, expectations, program materials, and manuals.
* Update and implement structures, processes, policies, and workflows.
* Conduct regular organizational assessments to identify volunteer needs across departments.
* Continue building and overseeing volunteer program systems (e.g., CRM, tracking tools).
* Establish risk management protocols, confidentiality guidelines, and compliance standards.

**Volunteer Recruitment**
-------------------------

* Develop and execute recruitment strategies to attract diverse volunteers, including patients, caregivers, and community supporters.
* Lead and track outreach campaigns via social media, newsletters, volunteer platforms, and events.
* Screen, interview, and select volunteers based on program needs and organizational fit.

**Onboarding, Training & Support**
----------------------------------

* Update, standardize, and improve on existing onboarding processes, including orientation materials, volunteer handbooks, and training modules.
* Deliver or coordinate volunteer training sessions specific to various program areas (advocacy, peer support, events, special projects).
* Ensure volunteers understand AiArthritis’ mission, values, and expectations.
* Provide ongoing support, coaching, and supervision for volunteers.

**Engagement, Retention & Recognition**
---------------------------------------

* Create systems to ensure volunteer satisfaction, support, and community-building.
* Develop recognition programs (e.g., awards, spotlights, newsletters, appreciation events).
* Maintain regular communication through email, text, WhatsApp and other volunteer platforms.
* Foster a positive, inclusive environment where volunteers feel valued and connected.

**Program Administration**
--------------------------

* Maintain accurate volunteer records, contact logs, hours tracking, and documentation.
* Evaluate volunteer performance and provide feedback or corrective guidance as needed.
* Track program metrics and produce reports for leadership and the board.
* Be responsible for volunteer scheduling, project assignments, and role transitions.
* Ensure compliance with nonprofit best practices and internal policies.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
----------------------------------

* Work with leadership, communications, patient education, and advocacy teams to integrate volunteers into organizational goals.
* Support events (virtual and in-person), campaigns, and initiatives requiring volunteer participation.
* Partner with the development team to identify volunteers who may transition into donors or who may lead fundraising events or other efforts.

**Program Growth & Innovation**
-------------------------------

* Continuously evaluate program effectiveness and impact. Identify, ideate, and implement improvements as needed.
* Build scalable systems to support significant volunteer expansion.
* Develop specialized volunteer tracks (advocates, peer educators, event support, fundraising, administrative, research ambassadors, high school/young volunteers, corporate employees, professional in-kind skilled services, etc).
* Stay up to date on nonprofit volunteer program best practices and implement trends to stay current.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* 5+ years of experience leading volunteer programs in a nonprofit setting.
* Experience building or significantly expanding a volunteer program.
* Strong project management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills and ability to work with diverse communities.
* Proven ability to recruit, train, motivate, and retain volunteers.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Proficiency with volunteer coordination or CRM platforms. Experience with Zoho is preferred.
* Proficiency with Google Drive.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager - West Coast
jobs.description:
#### **About the Job:**

The Senior Customer Success Manager reports directly into the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point-of-contact with our customers post-sales. They are LaunchDarkly subject-matter experts guiding our new and expanding customers towards implementation and adoption and helping them achieve their desired use-cases and realize value. The best candidate for this role will be passionate about customer success with a keen interest in software development and DevOps, balanced with a strong sales acumen. In LaunchDarkly GTM, we are all customer-obsessed and striving for massive year over year growth.

#### **Responsibilities:**

* Customer Onboarding: You will shepherd in new customers from the sales handoff through successful activation in the product. This includes building out success plans to get customers up to speed in the platform, project management through onboarding, helping customers leverage the most appropriate enablement paths and assessing customer's adoption on an ongoing basis.
* Risk Identification and Mitigation: You'll work to proactively identify and diagnose risk inhibiting adoption or that may cause churn and contraction. You'll own building a risk mitigation strategy and coordinating across the account team to effectively steer the customer to success.
* Technical Guidance: You'll maintain a deep level of LaunchDarkly product knowledge and be expected to provide customers with direction on implementation and adoption best practices.
* Prescriptively Sell: You maintain a pulse on how our customers are tracking against their key goals and outcomes identifying opportunities for customers to purchase additional products, services and adopt new features needed for them to maximize the value of our solution.
* Trusted Advisor: You understand your customers like no other and have built enough trust to act as an extension of their team. You provide prescriptive guidance to customers to help them get the most out of their LaunchDarkly purchase.
* Build Champions & Executive Relationships: You are an expert champion builder. You consistently work to identify & support key advocates within your customers' organization who actively promote the value of LaunchDarkly. In partnership with your Champion, you're able to leverage success metrics & value driven insights to gain sponsorship at an Executive level.
* Renewal and Expansion focused: You are comfortable owning a number and forecasting on a weekly basis. You will work directly with customers, sales and deal desk to execute renewal agreements on time and to identify expansion opportunities within your accounts

#### **About You:**

* Entrepreneurial and Self-Motivated: You are driven and proactive, taking ownership of your role and responsibilities. You operate with a high level of urgency at all times. You thrive in a fast paced, start-up environment.
* Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly. You view feedback as a necessity for growth so consistently seek it out and give it.
* Intellectual Curiosity: You have a hunger for knowledge and are naturally a question-asker.
* Excellent Communication: Your written and spoken communication skills are outstanding.
* Organized & Autonomous: You are capable of efficiently managing your workload and have a process for time management. You do not require a lot of external direction to prioritize your work.
* Highly Adaptable: You excel in a fast-paced and dynamic organizational setting.
* Strong Sales Acumen: You have a high level of sales acumen, strong negotiation skills and are eager to own a number. This is a commercially focused CS organization.
* Natural Problem Solver: You have strong critical thinking skills and enjoy the process of solving complex customer problems. You are able to escalate issues when necessary in a clear, effective manner.
* Team Player: You collaborate well with others, know when to pull specialists or leaders in and keep others informed proactively. Win as a team!

#### **Qualifications:**

* 5+ years in a customer-facing role, ideally in account management, customer/partner success or onboarding/implementation with a track record of exceeding targets.
* Experience owning the renewal process and being held accountable to a retention quota. This is a commercially oriented Customer Success team.
* Strong discovery and qualification skills; training in Command of the Message, MEDDIC or another sales methodology is preferred.
* Strong project management skills. You should have experience holding customers and cross-functional teams accountable to a timeline.
* Experience working on a technical product, ideally interacting with developers or other technical personas as your primary customer. Experience within the DevOps space preferred.
* Experience with both proactive and reactive customer success motions.
* We will teach you all about LaunchDarkly, but you should have an existing level of technical knowledge and know-how.
* Proven ability to advocate for both your customers and your company. You know how to be the voice of the customer in the company while mediating between the customer's requests and the company's vision.

**Pay:**

* Zone 1: *San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle* - *$171,200* *- $235,400*\*\*
* Zone 2: *Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100* *- $211,860*\*\*
* Zone 3: *All other US locations - $145,500* *- $200,090\**\*

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Support
jobs.description:
### **About the role:**

PetDesk’s Support team handles thousands of conversations every month with veterinary clinics and pet parents, and the way we deliver that support is changing fast. This role exists to lead our frontline team through that change while keeping the experience customers rely on every day running smoothly.

As Manager, Customer Support, you will be accountable for the satisfaction, loyalty, and trust that team builds with customers.

Your job is to coach and develop the team, help new members ramp quickly, and set clear standards for quality. You will move us toward more complete, first-time resolutions by improving workflows and using automation and AI where they make sense, so people spend their time where they add the most value. You will use data and customer insights to spot trends and pain points, and bring that voice of the customer to Support leadership and Product. You will work closely with Product and CX colleagues to ensure a consistent experience for every customer. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys talking directly with customers and pitches in wherever the team needs it.

### **Apply if you’re excited to:**

* Lead, coach, and grow a frontline support team that helps veterinary clinics and pet parents succeed with our products
* Onboard new team members and build consistent quality, confidence, and ownership across the team
* Run daily support operations across every channel, keeping queues healthy and escalations moving
* Rethink how support gets done, using automation, AI, and smarter workflows so more issues are fully resolved the first time
* Dig into support data and customer feedback to find trends, root causes, and opportunities that make a real difference
* Partner with Product and other teams to turn customer insights into better products and fewer repeat problems
* Talk directly with customers, earn their trust, and jump in wherever the team needs a hand

### **About You:**

* 5+ years of experience in customer support or customer experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment
* 2+ years of people leadership experience managing a frontline support team, including onboarding and coaching new hires
* Track record of improving support metrics such as CSAT, first contact resolution, and response times
* Hands-on experience with support platforms such as Zendesk, including workflows, reporting, and automation
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn support data and customer feedback into clear, practical improvements
* Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to engage customers directly and influence cross-functional partners
* Experience leading change, such as rolling out new processes, tools, or AI and automation in a support team

### **Benefits & Perks:**

* Medical coverage for employees and dependents (80-90% covered by employer)
* Employer HSA contribution with HDHP
* 401(k) match up to 3.5%
* Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental & Vision coverage available
* Basic Life and AD&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Time Off & 12 Paid Annual Holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Pawternity Leave, Financial Pet Adoption Support & Subsidized Pet Insurance
* $250 Annual Stipend for Learning and Development

*PetDesk is committed to pay equity and transparency, from the candidate experience through every stage of employment. We put our best foot forward from day one with competitive, fair offers, so you don't have to negotiate your way to what you're worth. Compensation is benchmarked against industry market data and organized into pre-defined ranges for each role.*

*We also believe great work deserves real recognition. Automatic annual increases tend to be small and spread evenly regardless of contribution, so we take a different approach. Adjustments are tied to clear performance criteria applied consistently to everyone, allowing us to invest most in the people making the biggest impact.*

PetDesk combines the industry's most user-friendly client engagement tools with the highest-rated pet parent app to simplify your veterinary clinic’s operations while strengthening client relationships.

Our recruiting process is rooted in “Who: The A Method of Hiring” and consists of an average 2-week hiring timeline. This standardized interview process allows candidates to answer the same questions, experience the same process, and ensure a fair candidate review from multiple perspectives.

Please, no external recruiters—candidate profiles submitted from external recruiting agencies will not be considered.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we're equally committed to building yours. We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what's possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.
