jobs.title: B2B Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
Comfrt is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer brands, dedicated to blending mental wellness, inclusivity, and elevated comfort into every piece we create. Our mission goes beyond clothing — we strive to build a community where everyone feels supported and seen.  
  
**About the Job:**  
We are looking for a customer-focused, highly organized **B2B Customer Experience Manager** to own and elevate the end-to-end experience for our business customers across bulk purchasing, corporate gifting, and wholesale retail marketplaces.

This role serves as the primary point of contact for business accounts, ensuring a seamless experience from initial inquiry and order placement through fulfillment, delivery, and post-purchase support. The ideal candidate combines exceptional customer service with strong operational execution, relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration to drive customer satisfaction, retention, and B2B revenue growth.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**B2B Customer Experience & Account Support**

* Own the end-to-end customer experience for B2B accounts, including wholesale buyers, corporate gifting clients, bulk purchasers, and marketplace business customers.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business account inquiries, order updates, product availability, pricing questions, shipping issues, returns, and escalations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business customers through proactive communication, responsive service, and thoughtful problem-solving.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and deliver personalized solutions that support repeat business and long-term account retention.
* Establish consistent service standards and communication workflows across all B2B customer touchpoints.

**Wholesale, Bulk Ordering & Corporate Gifting**

* Manage the customer experience for wholesale, bulk, and corporate gifting programs, from inquiry and quote coordination through order fulfillment and delivery.
* Coordinate large-volume orders, gifting projects, recurring orders, special requests, and time-sensitive deliveries.
* Partner with Operations, Inventory, and Finance teams to confirm product availability, order accuracy, delivery timelines, and customer requirements.
* Support custom order requests, gifting configurations, packaging requirements, gift messages, and other program-specific needs, as applicable.
* Monitor order progress and proactively communicate potential delays, inventory constraints, or fulfillment challenges.
* Identify opportunities to improve program workflows, increase repeat purchases, and strengthen the overall B2B offering.

**Wholesale Retail Marketplace Support**

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure's on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Join Evotix?**

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**Overview**

*The expected total earnings for this role is $100,000-150,000. This is made up of both a base salary and a commission package.*

Our customers already trust us. Your job is to keep that trust strong, and make it grow.

We truly value our customers. Happy, engaged customers renew. They renew for longer. And they buy more. That’s the chain this role runs on. You’ll own a large book of enterprise accounts, and your first job is making sure each customer is getting real value and feels heard. When they do, healthy, longer-term contracts and expansion follow.

You’ll work with **EHS Directors**, executives and budget holders, often in the same account at once. You’ll run many accounts, renewals, deals and stakeholders in parallel, and keep every one of them moving.

This is a fast, busy role. Priorities shift daily, deadlines are real, and the details matter. We need someone who thrives in that, stays organized under pressure, and acts with urgency.

**What You'll Do**

**Keep customers engaged and renewing**

* Build real relationships with day-to-day users, EHS Directors and executive sponsors in every account.
* Check in often and early. Know how each customer is doing, spot risk before it becomes a problem, and act fast.
* Own the renewal cycle from start to finish. Start conversations early, and aim for longer-term contracts, not short extensions.
* Work with Customer Success to make sure customers are adopting the product and getting results they can point to.
* Bring in the right people (Product, Implementation, leadership) when an account needs help.
* Your outcome: engaged customers, healthy contracts, and renewals that are on time and on longer terms.

**Grow our biggest accounts**

* Spot where Evotix can solve bigger problems, then sell additional modules and own expansion and upsell deals through to close.
* Study your customer base, then build account and territory plans that show where the next opportunity is.
* Sell consultatively to EHS Directors, C-level leaders and budget holders.
* Drive complex, multi-stakeholder deals to close, and prospect steadily to keep your pipeline full.
* Your outcome: a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline and wider adoption of the Evotix portfolio.
* **Deliver the best of Evotix**
* Work with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Consulting and customer squads to find and move opportunities forward.
* Line up pricing, collateral and deal strategy with sales leadership, and bring in Implementation at the right moment.
* Partner with Events and Marketing to raise our profile in target accounts.
* Share customer needs, market insight and competitor moves with Product and Marketing.
* Your outcome: a seamless customer experience and a repeatable renewal, upsell and cross-sell playbook.
* **Keep the deal machine tight**
* Keep CRM records, pipeline data, activity and forecasts complete and accurate, including renewal dates and account health.
* Handle tenders, service order forms and purchase-order requirements.
* Negotiate terms with guidance from sales leadership and get agreements signed.
* Represent Evotix at conferences, exhibitions and industry forums. Customer visits and international travel may be required.
* Your outcome: well-run deals, forecasts people can trust, and a smooth handover to Implementation.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Experience selling SaaS software, with a track record of hitting revenue targets.
* Proven success keeping customers happy and renewing, ideally on multi-year terms.
* Proven success growing existing accounts through expansion, upsell or cross-sell.
* Strong consultative selling skills, including with senior executives and several decision-makers at once.
* Experience building account plans, generating pipeline and moving complex deals forward.
* Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting, with CRM habits you don’t skip.
* Excellent organization and prioritization. You can juggle many accounts and stakeholders without dropping details.
* A sense of urgency. You move fast, follow up fast and finish what you start.
* Clear writing, resilience and flexibility when plans change.
* A hungry, self-starting, collaborative style. You’re honest, you listen well and you build relationships easily.
* **Desirable**
* Experience selling EHS, health and safety, sustainability or related enterprise software.
* Experience helping shape renewal, expansion or team-selling playbooks.
* Time in a PE-backed SaaS company or another fast-scaling business.

jobs.description:
**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
* Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

**Data architecture & engineering**

* Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.
* Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
* Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

**Measurement, attribution & analytics**

* Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
* Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
* Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
* Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
* Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

**Data quality, governance & enablement**

* Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
* Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
* Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

### **What will you bring?**

* 5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
* Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
* Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.
* Experience building or governing a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni, or a BI-native equivalent).

**Responsibilities:**

  

**SKU Mapping**

* Confirm and verify that every SKU is correctly mapped across the ERP, e-commerce, warehouse, and marketplace systems so each product has one consistent identifier and attribute set.
* Maintain SKU mapping tables and cross-reference files, and resolve duplicate, retired, bundled, or variant SKUs. Make sure this is being done across all business systems and data warehouses.
* Validate new product and variant setups against the mapping standards before they go live.
* Work with the Master Data Analyst to apply golden-record rules and naming conventions to product data.

**Cross-System Connections**

* Assist in maintain the data connections between systems that exchange product, pricing, and inventory data.
* Configure field mappings, sync rules, and transformations in integration tools, and document each connection.
* Support Ecommerce Team on any needs during product launch set up.
* Partner with BSA Team on new integrations and changes to existing ones.
* Test changes in a sandbox before they reach production and confirm that data arrives correctly downstream.

**Upkeep and Monitoring**

* Monitor sync jobs, integration logs, and error queues on a set schedule.
* Run routine data checks for missing attributes, mismatched SKUs, and stale records, and correct them before they affect orders.
* Keep integration documentation, mapping logic, and runbooks current.

**Troubleshooting**

* Investigate and resolve product data issues, failed syncs, and mismatched inventory or order records.
* Find root causes, not just symptoms, and log recurring issues so they can be fixed at the source.
* Escalate platform or infrastructure problems to BSA or Data Engineering with clear reproduction steps and impact.
* Communicate status and resolution timelines to Operations leadership and affected teams.

**Process and Reporting**

* Build and maintain reports on SKU data health, sync reliability, and open issues.
* Document standard operating procedures for SKU setup, mapping changes, and integration support.
* Recommend process improvements to the Senior Manager of Operations based on recurring issues and data trends.

**Qualifications:**

* 2-4 years of experience in product operations, data operations, supply chain operations, or a similar role that involves product data.
* Hands-on experience maintaining SKU or item master data in an ERP or inventory system, such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Fulfil.
* Practical experience with integration or ETL tools such as Celigo &Boomi including field mapping and troubleshooting sync failures.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data cleanup.
* Working knowledge of e-commerce platforms such as Shopify and their product catalog structure.
* Ability to read logs, trace data through connected systems, and identify root causes.
* Clear written communication for SOPs, runbooks, and issue updates.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage several open issues without close supervision.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with MDM concepts such as golden records, entity matching, and data governance.
* Experience with SQL or basic scripting for data checks.
* Experience with a Product Information Management (PIM) tool.
* Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.

**What Success Looks Like in One Year:**

* SKU mapping accuracy at or above 99% across connected systems, measured by monthly audits.
* Sync failures resolved within 1 business day, with recurring failures traced to a permanent fix.
* Zero unmapped SKUs at product launch.
* Documentation for every active integration and SOP kept current on a quarterly review cycle.

**Why Join Comfrt?**

* Be part of a purpose-driven company that's shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
* Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
* Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
* Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

*Comfort is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.*

### ***About Givzey | Version2.ai***

Join the Future of Autonomous Fundraising!

*Givzey |* *Version2.ai* (http://version2.ai) *is a fully remote, AI-native company that created the Autonomous Fundraising category in 2024, when it researched, developed, and deployed the world's first Autonomous AI to address the labor shortage and capacity gap in nonprofit fundraising. Fundraising teams have a finite capacity to reach donors with one-to-one communication, on average leaving 97% of donors to their organization receiving only marketing communications. A labor shortage compounds the problem: even when organizations want to hire more fundraisers, they often can't find them. The result is a significant capacity gap, where teams can't reach large pools of high-potential donors, resulting in important organizations with world-changing missions being unable to fully execute on their visions.*

*Version2.ai's Virtual Engagement Officers (VEOs) close the labor shortage gap with each VEO independently managing a portfolio of up to 1,000 donors, delivering personalized outreach through text, email, video, and robotically handwritten notes year-round. jobs.title: Instructional Designer
jobs.description:
***Position is for an Instructional Designer OR Senior Instructional Designer***

**Position Summary**

The Sr. Instructional Designer is responsible for the design, development, and ongoing improvement of learning programs and training content that support organizational and workforce capability needs. The primary focus of this position is the creation of new training programs and the review and modernization of existing learning content.

This position applies instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies to translate business, technical, and operational requirements into structured and effective learning solutions. The Sr. Instructional Designer works closely with subject matter experts and key stakeholders to ensure training content is accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of the organization and the energy industry.

The role requires a strong degree of independence and ownership. The Sr. Instructional Designer is expected to manage multiple learning initiatives simultaneously, establish and maintain project plans and priorities, coordinate content development and review activities, and drive work through completion with limited oversight.

**Primary Responsibilities**

· Design and develop new training programs based on identified business, workforce, and performance needs.

· Review, revise, and modernize existing training programs and learning materials to improve accuracy, relevance, consistency, and effectiveness.

· Apply instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and appropriate learning methodologies throughout the development process.

· Develop learning objectives, course structures, instructional content, assessments, facilitator materials, job aids, and other learning resources.

· Translate complex technical, operational, and business information into clear, structured, learner-focused content.

· Partner with subject matter experts to gather, validate, and organize technical and industry-specific information.

· Ensure training content reflects appropriate energy industry terminology, practices, processes, and operating context.

· Determine appropriate learning approaches and delivery methods based on the audience, subject matter, and desired performance outcomes.

· Establish and maintain standards, templates, and processes for training content development and maintenance.

· Manage multiple learning development projects, including project plans, timelines, stakeholder reviews, approvals, and deliverables.

· Maintain organized training documentation, source materials, content inventories, and version control.

· Establish processes for the periodic review and maintenance of existing learning content.

· Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs and use feedback, assessment results, and stakeholder input to identify opportunities for improvement.

· Independently identify issues, establish priorities, and drive learning initiatives from initial need through implementation.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

· Demonstrated knowledge of the energy industry, including an understanding of industry terminology, operations, business processes, and/or technical environments.

· Strong knowledge of instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and learning development methodologies.

· Demonstrated experience designing and developing training programs from initial concept through implementation.

· Experience evaluating, revising, and modernizing existing training content.

· Ability to synthesize complex technical or operational information and translate it into clear and effective learning content.

· Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of work with limited direction.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to content quality and accuracy.

· Ability to establish productive working relationships with technical subject matter experts, business leaders, and other stakeholders.

· Ability to facilitate in-person or virtual training, content-development discussions, resolve conflicting input, and move stakeholders toward decisions.

· Proficiency with learning technologies, eLearning development tools, and learning management systems appropriate to the organization.

**Education & Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Education, Organizational Development, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

· Relevant professional experience in instructional design, learning and development, training development, or a related field.

· Prior experience supporting learning within the energy industry or a comparable technical/operational environment strongly preferred.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Learning and development : 2 years (Required)
* energy sector: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
**Make a Difference Every Day!**

At Home Helpers of Santa Clara Valley, we believe everyone deserves to live safely, comfortably, and independently in the place they call home. We are looking for a compassionate, proactive, and highly organized **Client Care Coordinator** to join our team and help ensure exceptional care and service for our clients and their families.

This position is ideal for a professional with experience in home care, healthcare coordination, or case management who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, coordinating services, and making a meaningful difference in the lives of older adults and individuals with disabilities.

The Client Care Coordinator will oversee the client care process from the initial assessment and development of individualized service plans through ongoing monitoring, quality assurance, and client relationship management. The role requires a combination of office-based coordination, client and family communication, and regular field visits.

**Candidates with previous home care or healthcare care-coordination experience are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Assessments and Care Planning**

* Conduct initial in-home assessments to evaluate clients' needs, preferences, living environments, and safety concerns.
* Develop individualized, written service plans that reflect each client's needs, goals, preferences, and authorized non-medical services.
* Conduct reassessments and update service plans as client conditions, preferences, or circumstances change.
* Ensure intake paperwork, service agreements, and required documentation are completed before services begin.

**2. Client and Family Relationship Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, families, and authorized representatives regarding care coordination and service-related questions.
* Conduct regular quality assurance calls and in-home visits to assess client satisfaction and the effectiveness of services.
* Review caregiver visit notes and communicate with caregivers and families to identify changes in client needs or concerns.
* Address client complaints and service concerns promptly, document all communications, and coordinate appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Build trust with clients and families through proactive communication, responsiveness, and compassionate service.

**3. Caregiver Coordination and Service Quality**

* Partner with the Staffing Coordinator to match clients with caregivers based on client needs, preferences, schedules, and caregiver qualifications.
* Communicate client-specific needs, service plan expectations, household preferences, and safety considerations to assigned caregivers.
* Review caregiver daily visit notes and identify concerns, missed tasks, or changes that may require follow-up.
* Collaborate with the staffing team to monitor Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) exceptions, including missed clock-ins, late arrivals, and other scheduling concerns.
* Help coordinate emergency coverage and communicate service changes to minimize interruptions in care.
* Reinforce appropriate non-medical care boundaries and agency policies, including medication reminders rather than medication administration, as applicable to the authorized service plan.

**4. Compliance, Documentation, and Quality Assurance**

* Maintain accurate, timely, and complete client records, assessments, service plans, visit notes, incident reports, and communication logs in the agency's care management system.
* Ensure documentation and client care practices comply with applicable California Department of Social Services (CDSS) requirements, HIPAA privacy requirements, Joint Commission standards, and agency policies.
* Identify potential safety risks, service concerns, or changes in client condition and escalate them to the appropriate team members.
* Support internal quality assurance initiatives, record reviews, audits, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Protect confidential client information and follow established privacy and security procedures.

**5. Community Partnerships and Special Programs**

* Build and maintain professional relationships with referral sources, healthcare professionals, senior living communities, and community organizations.
* Coordinate with community partners and program representatives regarding referrals, service schedules, and appropriate non-medical client updates.
* Help clients and families identify appropriate community resources and support services.
* Contribute to client satisfaction, retention, and the continued growth of the agency's referral network.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

* **Experience:** At least 1 year of experience in home care coordination, healthcare case management, client care management, or a closely related healthcare service role. Candidates with substantial relevant experience in home care are preferred.
* **Home Care Knowledge:** Understanding of non-medical home care operations, client assessments, individualized service plans, caregiver coordination, and client safety.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and compassionately with older adults, families, caregivers, and community partners.
* **Organization:** Strong organizational, time-management, multitasking, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* **Technology:** Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace and comfort using scheduling, documentation, and care management software. Experience with WellSky or ClearCare is a plus.
* **Compliance:** Familiarity with HIPAA, California home care regulations, and Home Care Aide Registry requirements is preferred.
* **Education:** A degree in nursing, social work, gerontology, healthcare administration, or a related field is a plus but not required.
* **Bilingual Skills:** Bilingual candidates(Spanish) are strongly preferred to better serve our diverse client pop

### **The Role**

Midi is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Patient Experience to own the digital experience that helps women build a long-term relationship with Midi. Our goal is to be a patient's healthcare home, supporting more of her care needs both in and outside of telehealth visits. This role will shape the journey from the first visit and onward: how patients stay engaged, return for follow-up care, and discover the other ways Midi can support them. You will set the roadmap and work with Clinical Operations, Lifecycle Marketing, Data, Engineering, Design, and more to ship experiences that are trusted, empathetic, and measurably improve patient engagement and retention.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own the Patient Experience Roadmap:** Define the vision and roadmap for the web experience patients use across their care journey, from onboarding and visit preparation through follow-up care and long-term support. Set clear targets for engagement and retention, and prioritize the bets most likely to reach them.
* **Extend Care Beyond the Visit:** Identify and build the touchpoints that help patients get more of their care needs met with Midi, in and outside of telehealth visits, such as follow-up care, ongoing treatment support, and access to additional services.
* **Understand & Improve the Patient Journey:** Combine patient research, feedback, and funnel and cohort analysis to find where patients disengage or run into friction, then run experiments and ship improvements that build trust and keep patients coming back.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Serve as the product lead for patient experience, partnering closely with **Clinical Operations**, **Lifecycle Marketing**, **Data**, **Engineering**, and **Design**, and with other teams across Midi as needed. You will lead through influence, building shared goals and making tradeoffs clear across your cross-functional team.

### **Requirements**

* **Consumer Product Experience:** 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years building consumer-facing digital products and owning engagement or retention metric targets. You have a track record of delivering measurable outcomes in complex business areas.
* **Experimentation & Data Fluency:** Skilled in hypothesis-driven development, A/B testing, and funnel and cohort analysis. You work closely with data partners, are comfortable digging into the numbers yourself, and use results to guide product strategy.
* **Patient-Centered Design Sense:** A strong grasp of UX best practices and of how clarity, empathy, and ease of use shape trust and engagement in a healthcare experience. You can turn friction in a patient flow into a clear hypothesis and a testable solution.
* **Focus on Patient LTV:** A strong understanding of how onboarding, ongoing engagement, and lifecycle communication shape retention, repeat usage, and lifetime value. You are motivated by helping patients build a lasting relationship with Midi.
* **High-Agency Problem Solver:** An action-oriented, ownership mindset with the ability to break complex challenges into simple, scalable solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** A strong track record of leading cross-functional teams without direct authority across Clinical Operations, Lifecycle Marketing, Data, Engineering, and Design. You build alignment, balance competing priorities, and present clearly to stakeholders at all levels.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Healthcare or Healthtech Experience:** Prior experience in a healthcare or digital health environment with an understanding of how to balance patient engagement with privacy (HIPAA) and clinical compliance.
  

*This is a full-time W2 position. The base salary range is* ***160K-200K*** *and will depend on experience. Midi pays a competitive base salary, plus equity and benefits.*

new_jobs.title: Annotation Operations Lead, Autonomy
new_jobs.description:
Rivian Autonomy is seeking an AI Data Operation Lead to lead the people and processes that turn vehicle data into reliable training and evaluation datasets. Within the AI Platform organization, you will bring together labeling delivery, data quality, curation, and human review to support the development of our autonomous driving models.

You will lead internal teams and external partners, with accountability for delivery, quality, and cost. This includes making sure the data we send for annotation is usable, that accepted labels meet the model teams' requirements, and that reviewers can turn difficult driving events into actionable feedback for engineering.

You will work closely with Perception, Planning, Data Infrastructure, Eval Infrastructure, and Product to translate model-development priorities into operational plans and provide evidence for release decisions. We are looking for a leader who can develop managers and specialists, make clear tradeoffs when demand exceeds capacity, and build an operation that improves as our models, tools, and vehicle fleet evolve.

* **Lead the organization.** Set the operating plan for AI data operations, develop team leaders, and define responsibilities across employees, contractors, and vendors. Build capacity plans that account for annotation, quality review, and rework across concurrent programs.
* **Deliver data that model teams can use.** Translate training and evaluation needs into labeling specifications, reviewer guidance, delivery milestones, and acceptance criteria. Work with model teams on taxonomy changes and keep delivery aligned with their development cycles.
* **Improve data quality and yield.** Own the operational checks that determine whether collected vehicle data is ready for curation and labeling. Partner with collection and engineering teams to resolve sensor, calibration, and data-quality issues before they consume downstream annotation capacity.
* **Own vendor performance and spend.** Set service levels and quality expectations, evaluate suppliers, and manage capacity, pricing, and budgets with Finance and Procurement. Reconcile accepted work with invoices and address delivery or quality shortfalls through clear corrective actions.
* **Develop human evaluation and triage operations.** Build review workflows with autonomy and systems engineers to investigate driving events, classify recurring failures, and assemble the evidence needed for root-cause analysis. **Description**

  
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

We are looking for a TPO Business Analyst to join our TPO Business Strategy team to serve as the analytical engine connecting product development, operations, and enterprise partner feedback. This role will own product and process gap analysis — identifying where our TPO platform falls short against enterprise partner needs, investor requirements, and operational best practices — and translate those findings into actionable requirements for engineering and process improvements for operations. The ideal candidate will have experience in solar finance, business analysis, or operations and will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets, and Risk teams.

This position will be based out of San Francisco, CA or Santa Clara, CA with an in-office schedule set at the direct manager’s discretion in accordance with the company policies and procedures.

* Conduct end-to-end product and process gap analyses by mapping the TPO customer journey (sale creation through asset onboarding), identifying structural gaps, and categorizing them by severity and business impact — similar in scope to internal initiatives like Project Clarity.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to map complex multi-step processes, identify failure points, and propose structured solutions — comfort with process flow mapping and root cause analysis.

* Proficiency in Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (structured presentations for leadership audiences).

* Comfort working across multiple teams simultaneously (Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets) in a fast-paced environment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in residential solar TPO operations, loan servicing, or asset management — familiarity with milestone-based workflows (NTP, M1, M2, M3).

* Exposure to investor reporting, capital markets due diligence, or portfolio quality analysis in a renewable energy or structured finance context.

* Experience with process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma) or project management tools (Jira, Asana, Miro).

This is an opportunity to lead an end-to-end North American BESS business and shape its strategy, growth, product portfolio, commercial model, supply chain, and execution platform.

The role offers direct executive visibility with Qcells and Hanwha leadership and the opportunity to build a scalable BESS organization across the North American market.

Qcells is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

**COMPENSATION:**

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws, the anticipated annual base salary for this position is:

* Zone 1 (Bay Area, NYC): $120,400 – $144,400

  

* Zone 2 (CA, NJ, NY): $110,300 – $132,300

* Zone 3 (All others): $100,300 – $120,300

The applicable salary range is based on the employee’s primary work location. Individual compensation will be determined based on qualifications, relevant experience, education, skills, internal equity, and other business-related factors.

Headquartered in Irvine, California, HQCA has been rapidly expanding its business in North America through the expansion of products and solutions, including distributed energy solutions, direct-to-homeowner solar sales and financing, and EPC services. new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager - Healthcare
new_jobs.description:
###### **About Vasion**

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

###### **About the role**

Vasion is looking for a Technical Account Manager who becomes the technical point of contact for our healthcare customers after the sale, working with hospital and health-system IT teams, from day-to-day administrators to IT directors, to keep the platform healthy, adopted, and growing long after go-live. We modernize how organizations handle documents, print, and content workflows, replacing fragmented legacy tools with a single, secure platform. In healthcare, that means print and document workflows that clinicians never have to think about, and IT teams that are never surprised.

###### **At a Glance**

* **Segment:** Healthcare accounts: hospitals, health systems, and multi-site provider networks
* **Vertical focus:** Healthcare
* **Engagement model:** Post-sales technical ownership across adoption, retention, and expansion
* **Work model:** Remote; ability to travel up to 20% [confirm]
* **Success metrics:** Gross retention on assigned accounts, risk identified before the customer raises it, adoption milestones met, expansion ARR influenced

###### **What Success Looks Like**

You find problems before our customers do. Every account in your book has a current technical plan that the customer's own technical owner has agreed to, and that plan already accounts for the EHR upgrade, the new clinic opening, and the audit that are coming. Escalations end with a root cause and a fix that holds. Renewals are a confirmation, not a negotiation, because the technical trust was built a year earlier.

###### **What you'll do**

**Ownership of the technical relationship across healthcare accounts: preventing risk, driving adoption, and growing customers over time.**

* **Proactive technical advisory:** Anticipate deployment, adoption, and stability risk across your accounts before the customer raises it. Turn release changes, configuration drift, and usage patterns into recommendations that name the risk, the likely impact, and the choice available to the customer, and be clear about which conclusions are firm and which need more evidence.
* **Technical account planning:** Own a twelve-month technical plan for each account, grounded in the health system's real growth, projects, and constraints, and agreed with the customer's technical owner. Keep a forward calendar of EHR upgrades and cutovers, new site openings, acquisitions, audits, and clinical change freezes, so Vasion hears about them before they arrive as escalations.
* **Clinical workflow adoption:** Help customers get the full value of what they already own, including secure pull and badge-based printing, serverless print management, and EHR-connected print and document workflows across shared clinical workstations and virtual desktops. Convert unused capability into adoption commitments.
* **Escalation leadership:** Lead the technical response when one of your accounts escalates, especially when printing or document delivery touches patient-facing operations. Coordinate Support and Engineering, give the customer one voice, and confirm the fix has held before closing it out.
* **Service delivery and renewal support:** Manage entitlement consumption across your book, coordinate Professional Services, Support, and partners, and give Customer Success the technical input needed to protect renewals, quarters ahead.
* **Expansion:** Identify new use cases inside the account, such as document workflow and capture needs, and build the technical case with Customer Success and Sales.
* **Field feedback and enablement:** Share healthcare field insight with Product and Engineering, and contribute runbooks, health-check templates, and reference architectures to the shared library.

###### **What You Bring**

**Strong technical grounding, healthcare IT fluency, and a structured approach to keeping accounts healthy and growing:**

* **Post-sales technical advisory:** Health reviews, adoption planning, review delivery, escalation coordination, and clear communication from IT administrator to Director level.
* **Architecture and systems thinking:** Ability to read and critique a customer's deployment architecture, including multi-site and virtualized environments.
* **Networking and identity:** Troubleshooting DNS, proxies, and firewalls; strong grasp of LDAP and SSO (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping), plus badge and tap-to-authenticate workflows such as Imprivata.
* **Security and compliance:** Working knowledge of HIPAA and HITECH requirements as they apply to print and output management; awareness of SOC 2 and ISO.
* **Domain expertise:** Print, Workflow, and Output Automation in cloud and hybrid environments; familiarity with EHR platforms (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner) and the print and document patterns around them.
* **Technical toolbox:** Diagramming; bash and/or PowerShell; SQL basics; RESTful APIs; Jira; AI-assisted workflows.

###### **Qualifications**

**Hands-on post-sales experience and the technical depth to earn trust with customer administrators:**

* 3-5+ years in technical account management, post-sales engineering, or senior technical support for SaaS or enterprise software
* Track record owning enterprise accounts through renewal cycles and escalations
* Comfortable engaging technical owners and decision makers, with strong writing and presentation skills
*

new_jobs.description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

### **The Role**

Block is seeking a Compliance Technology Program Lead to ensure our Machine Learning and Heuristic detection models — and the data infrastructure that feeds them — are fit for purpose, for our fiat and virtual currency products. This role sits at the intersection of compliance, machine learning, and AI tooling: you will use modern intelligence tools, including Claude and other LLM-based agents, to automate significant portions of oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — turning a traditionally manual, documentation-heavy function into a scalable, defensible program. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering and BSA/AML Policy Teams to provide end-to-end technical oversight, effective challenge and ongoing monitoring throughout the model development lifecycle.

### **You Will**

* **Build with Modern AI Tools:** Use AI agents (Claude and similar LLM-based tools) to build automation that scales oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — including drafting requirements, exam-ready documentation, data quality monitoring and ongoing model performance reporting.
* Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints so that automated outputs remain defensible to regulators and independent monitors.
* Establish and maintain model and data governance frameworks aligned with SR 11-7, SR 26-2, and OCC 2011-12 so engineering teams can ship defensible models at pace. Provide effective challenge throughout the model development lifecycle and partner with the BSA/AML Policy Team and CAX stakeholders to ensure documentation is exam-ready.
* **Lead Ongoing Monitoring:** Lead the design and development of real-time dashboards to monitor model health, including input data monitoring and ongoing model performance.
* Set standards for threshold tuning and ongoing Below the Line (BTL) testing controls.
* Establish frameworks and triggers for identifying when model performance is degrading and requires tuning or deprecation. Partner during subsequent tuning exercises and ensure changes are within risk appetite and documented defensibly.
* **Provide End-to-End Oversight of Model Development:** Oversee Transaction Monitoring models, including heuristic and rules-based detection logic, threshold settings (below the line testing), and the data pipelines that feed alerts.
* Oversee blockchain analytics and screening tools (TRM, Chainalysis), with attention to typology coverage, alert quality, and integration with downstream investigations.
* Oversee Sanctions Screening models (LexisNexis), including list management, fuzzy-match tuning, and false-positive reduction.
* Oversee Customer Risk Scoring models, including segmentation logic, periodic recalibration, and effective challenge of risk drivers.
* Oversee the design and validation of AI-driven case resolution — LLM-based and ML-based models that triage, enrich, or disposition alerts — ensuring decisions are explainable, auditable, and defensible to regulators.

### **You Have**

* 7+ years of experience in compliance technology at regulated financial institutions, or as a consultant working with FIs.
* Hands-on experience building with modern AI tools — including Claude, GPT, or comparable LLM-based agents — and a track record of using them to automate work in production. This includes prompt engineering, designing agentic workflows, and integrating AI into operational processes.
* Experience with both Machine Learning and Heuristic models across Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, and Customer Risk Scoring.
* Experience with input data quality monitoring.
* Experience with model performance monitoring.
* Experience conducting AML model validations aligned with SR 11-7 and OCC 2011-12.
* Experience responding to examinations and consent orders, and working with regulators and independent monitors.
* Experience with virtual currencies, including the unique transaction monitoring and sanctions screening considerations they present.
* Familiarity with blockchain analytics and screening tools such as Chainalysis and TRM Labs.
* A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives.
* A working understanding of regulated financial services and corresponding compliance obligations.
* Familiarity with statistical concepts related to machine learning
Expertise in data analytics and visualization

new_jobs.description:
**Why Join Evotix?**

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**Overview**

*The expected total earnings for this role is $100,000-150,000. This is made up of both a base salary and a commission package.*

Our customers already trust us. Your job is to keep that trust strong, and make it grow.

We truly value our customers. Happy, engaged customers renew. They renew for longer. And they buy more. That’s the chain this role runs on. You’ll own a large book of enterprise accounts, and your first job is making sure each customer is getting real value and feels heard. When they do, healthy, longer-term contracts and expansion follow.

You’ll work with **EHS Directors**, executives and budget holders, often in the same account at once. You’ll run many accounts, renewals, deals and stakeholders in parallel, and keep every one of them moving.

This is a fast, busy role. Priorities shift daily, deadlines are real, and the details matter. We need someone who thrives in that, stays organized under pressure, and acts with urgency.

**What You'll Do**

**Keep customers engaged and renewing**

* Build real relationships with day-to-day users, EHS Directors and executive sponsors in every account.
* Check in often and early. Know how each customer is doing, spot risk before it becomes a problem, and act fast.
* Own the renewal cycle from start to finish. Start conversations early, and aim for longer-term contracts, not short extensions.
* Work with Customer Success to make sure customers are adopting the product and getting results they can point to.
* Bring in the right people (Product, Implementation, leadership) when an account needs help.
* Your outcome: engaged customers, healthy contracts, and renewals that are on time and on longer terms.

**Grow our biggest accounts**

* Spot where Evotix can solve bigger problems, then sell additional modules and own expansion and upsell deals through to close.
* Study your customer base, then build account and territory plans that show where the next opportunity is.
* Sell consultatively to EHS Directors, C-level leaders and budget holders.
* Drive complex, multi-stakeholder deals to close, and prospect steadily to keep your pipeline full.
* Your outcome: a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline and wider adoption of the Evotix portfolio.
* **Deliver the best of Evotix**
* Work with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Consulting and customer squads to find and move opportunities forward.
* Line up pricing, collateral and deal strategy with sales leadership, and bring in Implementation at the right moment.
* Partner with Events and Marketing to raise our profile in target accounts.
* Share customer needs, market insight and competitor moves with Product and Marketing.
* Your outcome: a seamless customer experience and a repeatable renewal, upsell and cross-sell playbook.
* **Keep the deal machine tight**
* Keep CRM records, pipeline data, activity and forecasts complete and accurate, including renewal dates and account health.
* Handle tenders, service order forms and purchase-order requirements.
* Negotiate terms with guidance from sales leadership and get agreements signed.
* Represent Evotix at conferences, exhibitions and industry forums. Customer visits and international travel may be required.
* Your outcome: well-run deals, forecasts people can trust, and a smooth handover to Implementation.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Experience selling SaaS software, with a track record of hitting revenue targets.
* Proven success keeping customers happy and renewing, ideally on multi-year terms.
* Proven success growing existing accounts through expansion, upsell or cross-sell.
* Strong consultative selling skills, including with senior executives and several decision-makers at once.
* Experience building account plans, generating pipeline and moving complex deals forward.
* Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting, with CRM habits you don’t skip.
* Excellent organization and prioritization. You can juggle many accounts and stakeholders without dropping details.
* A sense of urgency. You move fast, follow up fast and finish what you start.
* Clear writing, resilience and flexibility when plans change.
* A hungry, self-starting, collaborative style. You’re honest, you listen well and you build relationships easily.
* **Desirable**
* Experience selling EHS, health and safety, sustainability or related enterprise software.
* Experience helping shape renewal, expansion or team-selling playbooks.
* Time in a PE-backed SaaS company or another fast-scaling business.

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
* Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.

* Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
* Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

**Measurement, attribution & analytics**

* Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
* Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
* Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
* Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
* Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

**Data quality, governance & enablement**

* Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
* Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
* Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

### **What will you bring?**

* 5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
* Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
* Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.
* Experience building or governing a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni, or a BI-native equivalent).

new_jobs.description:
**GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S.**Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped consumers save nearly $75 billion on the cost of their prescriptions.

Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.

**About the Role:**

As a Sr. Account Manager on the Client Success team, you will be responsible for the relationship management of our top tier Pharmaceutical and Agency clients. You will ensure client satisfaction and contract renewals through timely and quality delivery of high-impact campaigns, as well as drive contract expansion (upsell/cross-sell) through proactive account management and collaboration with the Sales team.

If you are a driven, client-focused individual with a passion for digital marketing, the pharma industry, and a proven ability to deliver successful campaigns while driving revenue growth and maintaining long-term relationships, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with internal subject matter experts such as Business Intelligence, Advertising Operations, Product Management, and Marketing to deliver contracted, tailored solutions to customers
* Work closely with a dedicated Account Associate, delegating tasks effectively to ensure seamless execution and client satisfaction
* Manage implementation process by ensuring stakeholders deliver what is needed on time and within client expectations
* Analyze and deliver monthly program metrics to reinforce program ROI and to provide insights to help clients achieve business goals
* Own and drive Top Account Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), delivering performance insights, strategic recommendations, and opportunities for optimization
* Lead internal account planning sessions (internal QBRs with Sales) to align on account growth strategies, renewal planning, and expansion opportunities
* Identify and drive lead generation opportunities in collaboration with Sales, leveraging program insights and customer feedback to uncover new business opportunities
* Partner with Sales to support new business development and organic growth of accounts, including upselling and optimizing where applicable
* Work with clients and agency partners to manage the regulatory review submission process
* Oversee the creation of visual examples of programs using our enterprise CMS tool
* Stay up-to-date with industry trends, digital marketing best practices, and regulatory requirements in the Pharma space

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical client and account management
* Strong written/verbal communication, excellent relationship management skills, and sharp attention to detail
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical regulatory review (MLR / PRC)
* Ability to apply analytics and data to a value proposition
* Willingness to think critically and solve problems in new or creative ways
* A deep curiosity and interest in healthcare technologies
* Familiarity with CRM software like Salesforce and project management platforms like JIRA or TaskRay

All GoodRx employees are responsible for reviewing and complying with all Company safety and security policies and procedures, being vigilant and observant of potential security threats (including phishing attempts) and proactively communicating with the Security Team to raise any concerns.

At GoodRx, pay ranges are determined based on work locations and may vary based on where the successful candidate is hired. The pay ranges below are shown as a guideline, and the successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and other relevant business and organizational factors. These pay zones may be modified in the future. Please contact your recruiter for additional information.

San Francisco and Seattle Offices:

$121,000.00 - $193,000.00

New York Office:

$111,000.00 - $177,000.00

Santa Monica Office:

$101,000.00 - $161,000.00

Other Office Locations:

$91,000.00 - $145,000.00

GoodRx also offers additional compensation programs such as annual cash bonuses or commission, and annual equity grants for most positions as well as generous benefits. Our great benefits offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with a company match, an ESPP, unlimited vacation, 13 paid holidays, and 72 hours of sick leave. GoodRx also offers additional benefits like mental wellness and financial wellness programs, fertility benefits, generous parental leave, pet insurance, supplemental life insurance for you and your dependents, company-paid short-term and long-term disability, and more!

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company and industry. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of the best and brightest from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has a seat at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunities to excel.

With that said, research shows that women and other underrepresented groups apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria. GoodRx is committed to leveling the playing field, and we encourage women, people of color, those in the LGBTQ+ communities, individuals with disabilities, and Veterans to apply for positions even if they don’t necessarily check every box outlined in the job description. Please still get in touch - we’d love to connect and see if you could be good for the role!

GoodRx is committed to providing reasonable accommodation

Join the Future of Autonomous Fundraising!

*Givzey |* *Version2.ai* (http://version2.ai) *is a fully remote, AI-native company that created the Autonomous Fundraising category in 2024, when it researched, developed, and deployed the world's first Autonomous AI to address the labor shortage and capacity gap in nonprofit fundraising. Fundraising teams have a finite capacity to reach donors with one-to-one communication, on average leaving 97% of donors to their organization receiving only marketing communications. A labor shortage compounds the problem: even when organizations want to hire more fundraisers, they often can't find them. The result is a significant capacity gap, where teams can't reach large pools of high-potential donors, resulting in important organizations with world-changing missions being unable to fully execute on their visions.*

*Version2.ai's Virtual Engagement Officers (VEOs) close the labor shortage gap with each VEO independently managing a portfolio of up to 1,000 donors, delivering personalized outreach through text, email, video, and robotically handwritten notes year-round. VEOs don't just make staff more efficient; they manage donor portfolios independently, freeing human fundraisers to focus their time on the highest-value relationships while also closing transformational revenue for these organizations.*

*VEOs have already generated over $20M in fundraising revenue to date, including individual gifts as large as $100,000, at an opt-out rate of just 0.07%. Organizations deploying a VEO see 4x annual ROI on average, and the top 20% see 8x or higher. new_jobs.title: Instructional Designer
new_jobs.description:
***Position is for an Instructional Designer OR Senior Instructional Designer***

**Position Summary**

The Sr. Instructional Designer is responsible for the design, development, and ongoing improvement of learning programs and training content that support organizational and workforce capability needs. The primary focus of this position is the creation of new training programs and the review and modernization of existing learning content.

This position applies instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies to translate business, technical, and operational requirements into structured and effective learning solutions. The Sr. Instructional Designer works closely with subject matter experts and key stakeholders to ensure training content is accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of the organization and the energy industry.

The role requires a strong degree of independence and ownership. The Sr. Instructional Designer is expected to manage multiple learning initiatives simultaneously, establish and maintain project plans and priorities, coordinate content development and review activities, and drive work through completion with limited oversight.

**Primary Responsibilities**

· Design and develop new training programs based on identified business, workforce, and performance needs.

· Review, revise, and modernize existing training programs and learning materials to improve accuracy, relevance, consistency, and effectiveness.

· Apply instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and appropriate learning methodologies throughout the development process.

· Develop learning objectives, course structures, instructional content, assessments, facilitator materials, job aids, and other learning resources.

· Translate complex technical, operational, and business information into clear, structured, learner-focused content.

· Partner with subject matter experts to gather, validate, and organize technical and industry-specific information.

· Ensure training content reflects appropriate energy industry terminology, practices, processes, and operating context.

· Determine appropriate learning approaches and delivery methods based on the audience, subject matter, and desired performance outcomes.

· Establish and maintain standards, templates, and processes for training content development and maintenance.

· Manage multiple learning development projects, including project plans, timelines, stakeholder reviews, approvals, and deliverables.

· Maintain organized training documentation, source materials, content inventories, and version control.

· Establish processes for the periodic review and maintenance of existing learning content.

· Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs and use feedback, assessment results, and stakeholder input to identify opportunities for improvement.

· Independently identify issues, establish priorities, and drive learning initiatives from initial need through implementation.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

· Demonstrated knowledge of the energy industry, including an understanding of industry terminology, operations, business processes, and/or technical environments.

· Strong knowledge of instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and learning development methodologies.

· Demonstrated experience designing and developing training programs from initial concept through implementation.

· Experience evaluating, revising, and modernizing existing training content.

· Ability to synthesize complex technical or operational information and translate it into clear and effective learning content.

· Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of work with limited direction.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to content quality and accuracy.

· Ability to establish productive working relationships with technical subject matter experts, business leaders, and other stakeholders.

· Ability to facilitate in-person or virtual training, content-development discussions, resolve conflicting input, and move stakeholders toward decisions.

· Proficiency with learning technologies, eLearning development tools, and learning management systems appropriate to the organization.

**Education & Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Education, Organizational Development, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

· Relevant professional experience in instructional design, learning and development, training development, or a related field.

· Prior experience supporting learning within the energy industry or a comparable technical/operational environment strongly preferred.

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)
